---
title: "Drawer"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
source(file.path("..", "..", "shots.R"))
```

Sometimes, `Dialog` does not always satisfy our requirements, let's say you have a massive form, or you need space to display something like `terms & conditions`, `Drawer` has almost identical API with `Dialog`, but it introduces different user experience.

> **Tip**
>
> Since v-model is natively supported for all components, `visible.sync` has been deprecated, use `v-model="visibilityBinding"` to control the visibility of the current drawer.

## Basic Usage

Callout a temporary drawer, from multiple direction

You must set `model-value` for `Drawer` like `Dialog` does to control the visibility of `Drawer` itself, it's `boolean` type. `Drawer` has three parts: `title` & `body` & `footer`, the `title` is a named slot, you can also set the title through attribute named `title`, default to an empty string, the `body` part is the main area of `Drawer`, which contains user defined content. When opening, `Drawer` expand itself from the **right corner to left** which size is **30%** of the browser window by default. You can change that default behavior by setting `direction` and `size` attribute. This show case also demonstrated how to use the `before-close` API, check the Attribute section for more detail

The radios set the edge it slides from, the drawers' `direction`
following them with [v_bind()]; each opens from a store's field,
[v_model()],
and closing the first asks first, through `before_close`.

```{r basic-usage, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = c("Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#direction .el-radio')).find(function(r){ return r.innerText.indexOf('top to bottom') >= 0; }).click()", "document.querySelector('#open_container button').click()"), shot_sel = ".el-drawer", shot_wait = 1.5, shot_expect = "document.querySelector('#drw .el-drawer.ttb')"}
vue_store(
  "drawers",
  state = list(first = FALSE, second = FALSE, choice = "Option 1")
)
el_radio_group(
  "direction",
  choices = c(
    "left to right" = "ltr",
    "right to left" = "rtl",
    "top to bottom" = "ttb",
    "bottom to top" = "btt"
  ),
  value = "rtl"
)
el_button(
  "open",
  "open",
  type = "primary",
  on = list(click = "$vueStore.drawers.first = true")
)
el_button(
  "open2",
  "with footer",
  type = "primary",
  on = list(click = "$vueStore.drawers.second = true")
)
el_drawer(
  "drw",
  title = "I am the title",
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.drawers.first"),
  direction = v_bind("$inputs.direction"),
  before_close = JS(
    "function(done) { if (confirm('Are you sure you want to close this?')) done(); }"
  ),
  content = tags$span("Hi, there!")
)
el_drawer(
  "drw2",
  title = tags$h4("set title by slot"),
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.drawers.second"),
  direction = v_bind("$inputs.direction"),
  content = el_radio_group(
    "radio1",
    choices = c("Option 1", "Option 2"),
    value = v_model("$vueStore.drawers.choice"),
    size = "large"
  ),
  footer = tags$div(
    style = "flex: auto",
    el_button(
      "cancel",
      "cancel",
      on = list(click = "$vueStore.drawers.second = false")
    ),
    el_button(
      "confirm",
      "confirm",
      type = "primary",
      on = list(
        click = "$vueStore.drawers.second = false; $message('You chose ' + $vueStore.drawers.choice)"
      )
    )
  )
)
```

## No Title

When you no longer need a title, you can remove it from the drawer.

Set the `withHeader` attribute to **false**, you can remove the title from drawer, thus your drawer can have more space on screen. If you want to be accessible, make sure to set the `title` attribute.

```{r no-title, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = "document.querySelector('#open_container button').click()", shot_sel = ".el-drawer", shot_wait = 1.5}
vue_store("untitled", state = list(visible = FALSE))
el_button(
  "open",
  "open",
  type = "primary",
  on = list(click = "$vueStore.untitled.visible = true")
)
el_drawer(
  "drw",
  title = "I am the title",
  with_header = FALSE,
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.untitled.visible"),
  content = tags$span("Hi there!")
)
```

## Customized Content

Like `Dialog`, `Drawer` can be used to display a multitude of diverse interactions.

```{r customization-content, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = "document.querySelector('#open_container button').click()", shot_sel = ".el-drawer", shot_wait = 1.5}
vue_store("form_drawer", state = list(visible = FALSE))
el_button(
  "open",
  "Open Drawer with nested form",
  text = TRUE,
  on = list(click = "$vueStore.form_drawer.visible = true")
)
el_drawer(
  "drw",
  title = "I have a nested form inside!",
  direction = "ltr",
  size = "40%",
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.form_drawer.visible"),
  content = tagList(
    el_input(
      "name",
      label = "Name",
      label_position = "left",
      label_width = "80px"
    ),
    el_select(
      "area",
      choices = c("Area1" = "shanghai", "Area2" = "beijing"),
      label = "Area",
      label_position = "left",
      label_width = "80px"
    )
  ),
  footer = tagList(
    el_button(
      "cancel",
      "Cancel",
      on = list(click = "$vueStore.form_drawer.visible = false")
    ),
    el_button(
      "submit",
      "Submit",
      type = "primary",
      on = list(click = "$vueStore.form_drawer.visible = false")
    )
  )
)
```

## Customized Header

The `header` slot can be used to customize the area where the title is displayed. In order to maintain accessibility, use the `title` attribute in addition to using this slot, or use the `titleId` slot property to specify which element should be read out as the drawer title.

```{r customization-header, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = "document.querySelector('#open_container button').click()", shot_sel = ".el-drawer", shot_wait = 1.5}
vue_store("header_drawer", state = list(visible = FALSE))
el_button(
  "open",
  "Open Drawer with customized header",
  on = list(click = "$vueStore.header_drawer.visible = true")
)
el_drawer(
  "drw",
  show_close = FALSE,
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.header_drawer.visible"),
  content = "This is drawer content.",
  title = tags$div(
    style = "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center",
    tags$h4("This is a custom header!"),
    el_button(
      "close",
      "Close",
      type = "danger",
      icon = "CircleCloseFilled",
      on = list(click = "$vueStore.header_drawer.visible = false")
    )
  )
)
```

## Resizable Drawer

Try to drag the edge part.

Set `resizable` to `true` to resize.

Picking an edge opens it there; dragging its inner edge resizes it,
reported as `input$<id>_resize`.

```{r resizable, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = "Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#direction .el-radio-button')).find(function(r){ return r.innerText.trim() === 'bottom'; }).click()", shot_sel = ".el-drawer", shot_wait = 1.5, shot_expect = c("document.querySelector('#drw .el-drawer.btt')", "getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('drw')).display !== 'none'")}
vue_store("resizing", state = list(visible = FALSE))
el_radio_group(
  "direction",
  choices = c(top = "ttb", right = "rtl", bottom = "btt", left = "ltr"),
  value = "rtl",
  button = TRUE,
  on = list(change = "$vueStore.resizing.visible = true")
)
el_drawer(
  "drw",
  direction = v_bind("$inputs.direction"),
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.resizing.visible"),
  resizable = TRUE,
  content = "This is drawer content."
)
```

## Nested Drawer

You can also have multiple layer of `Drawer` just like `Dialog`.

If you need multiple Drawer in different layer, you must set the `append-to-body` attribute to **true**

```{r nested-drawer, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = "document.querySelector('#open_container button').click(); setTimeout(function(){ document.querySelector('#inner_open_container button').click(); }, 800);", shot_sel = ".el-drawer", shot_wait = 2}
vue_store("nested_drawers", state = list(outer = FALSE, inner = FALSE))
el_button(
  "open",
  "open",
  type = "primary",
  on = list(click = "$vueStore.nested_drawers.outer = true")
)
el_drawer(
  "outer",
  title = "I'm outer Drawer",
  size = "50%",
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.nested_drawers.outer"),
  content = tagList(
    el_button(
      "inner_open",
      "Click me!",
      on = list(click = "$vueStore.nested_drawers.inner = true")
    ),
    el_drawer(
      "inner",
      title = "I'm inner Drawer",
      append_to_body = TRUE,
      visible = v_model("$vueStore.nested_drawers.inner"),
      content = tags$p("_(:з)∠)_")
    )
  )
)
```

## Modal

Setting `modal` to `false` will hide modal (overlay) of drawer.

Starting from version 2.11.7, `modal-penetrable` attribute is added, which can be penetrable.

```{r modal, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = "document.querySelector('#open_container button').click()", shot_sel = ".el-drawer", shot_wait = 1.5}
vue_store("modal_drawer", state = list(visible = FALSE))
el_button(
  "open",
  "Open the modal Drawer",
  plain = TRUE,
  on = list(click = "$vueStore.modal_drawer.visible = true")
)
el_drawer(
  "drw",
  modal = FALSE,
  modal_penetrable = TRUE,
  visible = v_model("$vueStore.modal_drawer.visible"),
  content = tags$span("It's a modal Drawer"),
  footer = tagList(
    el_button(
      "cancel",
      "Cancel",
      on = list(click = "$vueStore.modal_drawer.visible = false")
    ),
    el_button(
      "confirm",
      "Confirm",
      type = "primary",
      on = list(click = "$vueStore.modal_drawer.visible = false")
    )
  )
)
```

> **Tip**
>
> The content inside Drawer should be lazy rendered, which means that the content inside Drawer will not impact the initial render performance, therefore any DOM operation should be performed through `ref` or after `open` event emitted.

> **Tip**
>
> Drawer provides an API called `destroy-on-close`, which is a flag variable that indicates should destroy the children content inside Drawer after Drawer was closed. You can use this API when you need your `mounted` life cycle to be called every time the Drawer opens.
